As there is a certain imbalance in the loading profile of explorer depending on which API methods are used I propose to divide explorer nodes into two groups: "full" - with extensive indexes, and "light" - with only those indexes that are necessary for most essential API methods. 
1. I'm releasing a version of explorer-backend with configurable indexes
2. a. On some of the offficial explorer nodes we re-deploy "light" versions of explorer without extensible indexes
    b. On a few other nodes we deploy full explorer
    c. We route those requests which are using "expensive" API methods to the full explorers. Others are served by light ones

I ask all dApp devs who rely on the official explorer to let me know which API methods are essential for your app so we can define the amount of servers needed.
